messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Final outcome: refund_full, amount $6.61 as a Ryde voucher. Account flag: no. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver..
Reasoning:
Driver cancelled the completed-booking pickup (cancelled_by = driver, 13:05:30, $6.61 fee on record), so the case enters through NS-0 and turns on whether the driver's no-show claim satisfies NS-1 (i)–(iii) [F4][F7][NS-0]. The driver did confirm arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 at 39 m from pickup, and the closest approach was 38 m, so (i) and (ii) pass [F1][F6][NS-1]. The continued-wait requirement (iii) fails: after the 13:02:35 tap the driver stayed inside the 200 m radius for only 175 seconds before cancelling at 13:05:30, under the 180-second (> 3 min) threshold; the stationary spell of 3 min 15 s began at 13:02:15, i.e. before the tap, and pre-tap waiting does not count under NS-1 (iii) [F3][F6][NS-1]. Chat #2 "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" is the driver's own assertion of elapsed time and does not extend the measured post-tap wait [F10][NS-1]. Because one of the NS-1 elements fails, the $6.61 must be fully refunded to the rider [F7][NS-2]. The NS-2 rider-side flag is not triggered: the trace shows the arrival confirmation was made at 39 m from pickup, i.e. no fake or off-location confirmation [F1][F6][NS-2]. The driver's profile (2 disputes, 1 upheld no-show, 772 trips) supports nothing on its own and RD-6 concerns upheld route deviation, not no-shows, so no account flag is raised [F17][RD-6]. Amount: the fee charged is $6.61 and is refunded in full — $6.61 [F7][NS-2].

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments:
{"rider": "Good news — you're getting your $6.61 cancellation fee back as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: your driver did tap "I'm Here" near the pickup point, but the wait after that tap fell short of the required three minutes before the ride was cancelled. Because that requirement wasn't met, the fee shouldn't have been charged.

The full $6.61 goes to your Ryde account as a voucher — no need to do anything.

No action is being taken against your account, and nothing else changes for you.", "driver": "We reviewed the cancellation on this trip. The $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: your "I'm Here" tap was logged near the pickup point, but the wait recorded after that tap was under the three minutes required before cancelling for a no-show. The time you waited before tapping doesn't count toward that requirement.

No action is being taken against your account this time, and your account stays in good standing.

Reminder for next time: after tapping "I'm Here", wait the full three minutes before cancelling a no-show."}
